decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting narratives regarding the identity of Henrietta Maria O'Donel White Culpeper's spouse. Document 1 (D1) explicitly identifies 'Christopher Barton' as her husband in section D1S7 ('...sight of her husband... Christopher Barton'). Document 2 (D2) explicitly identifies 'Louis Symonds Tindal' as her husband in section D2S15 ('The marriage of Henrietta Maria O'Donel White Culpeper to Louis Symonds Tindal...') and D2S17. Per the instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers where competing assertions exist without resolving them as errors, both names are returned as valid answers based on their respective source contexts.
